text: Employees accrue 15 vacation days per year. Request time off in the HR portal at least two weeks in advance.
Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days. Meals over 75 dollars require an itemized receipt.
New hires complete security training in the first week. Contact IT at helpdesk to set up your laptop and VPN.
To connect to the corporate VPN, install the client, sign in with your SSO credentials, and choose the nearest gateway.
